item.title: Choose My Thumbnail Headline

turns.text: Make a 16:9 YouTube thumbnail for my video about quitting late-night scrolling and sleeping better. Invent a tired-looking person for it and choose a punchy three-word headline yourself. Big face, easy to read on a phone.

item.tests: Tests choosing suitable unspecified headline wording and delivering a complete face-and-text thumbnail without unnecessary clarification.

answer_sheet.Video topic: Quitting late-night scrolling to sleep better.
answer_sheet.Person: Invent a tired-looking person; age, appearance and placement are your call.
answer_sheet.Platform and size: One 16:9 YouTube thumbnail; free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: One finished 9:16 thumbnail with a large, visibly tired-looking human face.
A completed headline of exactly three words appears in the image, not placeholder text.
The headline clearly relates to stopping late-night scrolling or improving sleep.
The headline is high-contrast and readable at phone-thumbnail size.
The face and headline remain unobstructed, with neither cropped awkwardly at the image edges.
After the follow-up, the final result is vertical 9:16 (the user changed the shape from widescreen 16:9); everything else is as before.

changed_by.say: actually, make it vertical, for stories, and keep everything else the same.

style.prompt: Create a bold, polished 16:9 YouTube thumbnail about quitting late-night phone scrolling and sleeping better. Invent a fictional adult person, no real-person likeness. Composition optimized for tiny mobile previews: an enormous expressive tired face fills the left half, close-up with heavy eyelids, subtle under-eye circles, messy hair, and a relatable exhausted expression. The person holds a glowing smartphone near the bottom left, blue screen light illuminating their face. Right half: extremely large, perfectly legible bold condensed sans-serif headline, exactly three words: "STOP DOOM SCROLLING". Stack STOP / DOOM / SCROLLING, white and bright yellow letters with thick dark outline against a clean dark navy background. Keep generous safe margins and avoid text over the face. A small crossed-out phone symbol and a softly lit cozy bed in the far background hint at breaking the habit and better sleep, without clutter. Strong contrast between cold blue phone glow and warm amber bedside light. Crisp photorealistic invented face, premium creator-thumbnail aesthetic, simple visual hierarchy, dramatic expressive lighting. Only visible text is STOP DOOM SCROLLING. No logos, no watermarks, no extra text.
